name: Molise
summary: A light blue field with the regional arms, a red shield with a silver diagonal band and an eight-pointed star, above the words 'Regione Molise'.
origin: The arms derive from those of the medieval Counts of Molise. The flag was in use by the mid-1990s.

symbols.name: Eight-pointed star
symbols.description: A white star in the upper hoist of the shield.
symbols.meaning: From the arms of the Counts of Molise.

facts: Molise separated from Abruzzo in 1963, becoming Italy's youngest region.
clues: A red shield with a silver diagonal band and a star, on light blue.
Italy's youngest region, split from its neighbour in 1963.
